run_gtn_loss_example: run the pytorch GTN loss example to compute sequence criterion loss and gradients
create_target_graph: create a target graph from a token sequence where each token can align to multiple frames
compute_gtn_forward_loss: compute the forward loss by intersecting target and emission graphs and scoring with forward_score
compute_gtn_backward_gradients: compute gradients for each batch example using gtn backward and extract weights to numpy
use_gtn_loss_function: use the GTNLoss function to compute a sequence criterion loss between frame-level input and token-level target
